detail.notFoundMessage: This tenant does not exist, or you are not a member of it.

members.title: Members
members.pendingInstructionsText: Not signed in yet. Ask {email} to sign up with this exact email, then check it for a verification email before logging in — this app has not sent them anything.

form.slugImmutable: The slug cannot be changed after creation.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.description: Add an existing Open Gateway user to this tenant by email.
invite.notFoundError: No user with this email has signed in yet. They need to register and log in once before you can invite them.
invite.alreadyMemberError: This user is already a member of this tenant.

invite.offerText: No account exists yet for {email}. You can invite them by email instead — this app will not send them anything; ask them to sign up with this exact email, then check it for a verification email before logging in.
invite.inviteSuccessToast: Invited {email} by email — ask them to sign up with this address before logging in.

remove.title: Remove this member?
remove.descriptionSuffix: loses access to this tenant immediately.

quota.sheetDescription: The ceiling above every key this tenant issues.

quota.isInactiveHint: Refuses every request from this tenant, regardless of quota.

errors.quotaMaxInvalid: Must be a whole number of at least -1

quota.inactiveNotice: This tenant is currently cut off — every request is refused.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Metered calls against this tenant's org-level quota.
usage.noQuota: No org quota configured for this tenant.

suspend.title: Suspend this tenant?
suspend.description: Its members lose access immediately. You can reactivate it later.

archive.title: Archive this tenant?
archive.description: This is a soft delete: the tenant and its data are kept but it becomes unusable. This cannot be undone from this page.
